test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U,V and X are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact middle of the sides. P and R sit at diagonally opposite corners. P sits second to the left of S. Q does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. V sits between R and S. X sits second to the right of V. S is not an immediate neighbour of T. Who sits third to the right of V?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T, U,V and X are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact middle of the sides.

1) P and R sit at diagonally opposite corners.

2) P sits second to the left of S.

3) V sits between R and S.

4) X sits second to the right of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d3cbf665fd0e0887e83d845a579095cf9f144e9fec4ce2b0268bccd990984bc.png] 

5) Q does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

6) S is not an immediate neighbour of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc20cafc3a8f30125d5d779232b2c58da738ad183f6b10bdd25def9b2d97a450.png] 

Here, 'Q' sits third to the right of V.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
